import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_24/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV file
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as the target ['condition', 'click'],
# we can union (concatenate) them directly.
# Here, only one source table exists, so just use it directly.
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is ['condition': integer, 'click': integer]
# Ensure the data types match exactly
combined_df = combined_df.astype({'condition': 'int64', 'click': 'int64'})

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_24/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
